data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 39.8 million in 2022, representing 3.13% of its opening gross reserves. This strengthening was primarily driven by higher-than-expected attritional loss experience on Financial Lines and Liability classes, and the impact of inflation loadings on prior accident year reserves. While there were positive developments across other classes, these were offset by the adverse movements. The overall development was also influenced by changes in actuarial assumptions and the discounting of outstanding reserves.

data.data_quality_notes: The comparative figures in the Statement of Cash Flows have been restated to correct the classification of foreign exchange movements (previously included in the technical provisions) to Foreign Exchange in cash flows from operating activities in line with FRS 102 requirements. The correction results in an increase of GBP 20m in the Technical Provisions and an equivalent decrease in the Foreign Exchange. This restatement does not impact the total operating cash flows, profit and loss account or the balance sheet.
